scripts.dev: npm run env:local && concurrently "npm --workspace services/content-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/storage-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/trust-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/auth-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/newsroom-service run dev" "npm --workspace apps/frontend-main run dev"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm --workspace services/content-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/storage-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/trust-service run dev" "npm --workspace services/auth-service run dev"
scripts.dev:frontends: npm run env:local && concurrently "npm --workspace apps/frontend-main run dev"
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/with-env.js npm --workspace packages/db run migrate:deploy
scripts.db:seed:newsroom: node scripts/with-env.js npm --workspace packages/db run seed:newsroom
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/with-env.js npm --workspace packages/db run seed
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/with-env.js npm --workspace packages/db exec -- prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.dev:full: npm run db:up && npm run minio:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run build:services && npm run db:seed:dev && npm run dev:local
